ws_testing_policy.title: Testing Policies
values: Generators with 'firmware update pending' in Notes must not be load tested until the update is completed and verified. Skip these generators when scheduling tests.

ws_testing_policy_q1_update.title: Q1 2026 Testing Policy Update
values: Effective Q1 2026, generators in buildings currently under fuel rationing (see ws_fuel_rationing) must not be scheduled for load testing. Load testing consumes significant fuel and is prohibited during rationing periods. Check the ws_fuel_rationing worksheet for buildings with active rationing status.
When scheduling load tests, prefer weekday scheduling (Monday-Friday). This is a preference only and does not affect which generators are due for testing.
